channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Sánchez Targets Toughest Comeback Yet With Early Spain Election
item.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has a history of proving his critics wrong. But his decision Monday to call a snap election in the midst of a housing affordability crisis may be his most precarious political move to date.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Basteiro

item.title: Bolsonaro Pushes Lula to Brink of Defeat Ahead of Runoff
item.description: Brazil's presidential election is headed to a runoff after a weekend of voting didn't result in either candidate achieving the necessary majority. Beatriz Reis explains what's at stake for Flávio Bolsonaro, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and the country (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Plans to Ease Limits on Tax-Exempt Diesel Variety
item.description: President Donald Trump is preparing to ease limits restricting the use of a tax-exempt variety of diesel, his latest bid to pare costs for the essential fuel ahead of the November midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Jennifer A. Dlouhy

item.title: Brazil Real Surges After Bolsonaro Takes Surprising Lead
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro took a surprise lead over Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the first round of Brazil’s presidential election, making him the favorite to win the runoff which is to be held October 25. Brazil's real surged against the dollar in Sao Paulo Monday morning. Bloomberg's Travis Waldron reports from Brazil. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Germany and France Push Trade Weapon to Bar China Access
item.description: Germany and France are urging the European Union to adopt new powers that would enable the bloc to cut off access to its single market if China or other nations destabilize trade relations.
item.dc:creator: Arne Delfs and Jorge Valero

item.title: How Data Centers are Shaping the Midterm Elections
item.description: Nicol Turner Lee, Senior Fellow of Governance Studies at the Brookings Institution joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the impact of data centers on voters as the midterm elections come closer. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: FlyDubai Incident Turns Into Battleground in Israeli Election
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was quick to seize the opportunity to associate himself with the heroics of Israelis who helped stop a FlyDubai co-pilot from crashing a plane bound for Tel Aviv.
item.dc:creator: Galit Altstein

item.title: India Top Court Questions Election Body Over Voter Roll Changes
item.description: India’s Supreme Court questioned changes to a form used to register new voters, raising fresh challenges to an overhaul of electoral rolls that’s been criticized by opposition groups.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Roy and Shruti Mahajan

item.title: Tensions Rise in Gulf as Yemen Tries to Take Back Land
item.description: Yemen's government launches a new offensive to try and take back Houthi-held territory. Yemen is backed by Saudi Arabia. The Houthi's are supported by Iran. Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall sorts out the latest on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Euro Weakens to 17-Month Low; Bolsonaro Takes Lead Over Lula in Brazil Election
item.description: Global equities waver as political upheaval sends the euro to a 17-month low. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez calls an early election amid mounting social protests over housing. Flávio Bolsonaro takes a surprise lead over President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the first round of Brazil's presidential election. Yemen's government launches a full-scale military campaign to recapture Houthi-held territory. Elsa Lignos of RBC Capital Markets joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss Europe’s public finances weighing on risk sentiment. Nicol Turner Lee of the Brookings Institution discusses how data centers are shaping the midterm elections. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Can the ECB Solve France's Debt Crisis?
item.description: France's fiscal crisis is helping drive the euro lower. TD Securities Head of FX Strategy Jayati Bharadwaj talks about how France is trying to keep the crisis in check and what role the ECB plays. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Spain’s Sánchez Calls Snap Election, Super Rich Exit the UK
item.description:
The exodus of the uber-rich from the UK has become a $160 billion problem, with individuals tracked in the Bloomberg Billionaires Index loosening their ties with the UK or cutting them entirely in the past two years.
Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez called an early election for Nov. 29 after parliament rejected a housing plan last week that his government had hoped would quell mounting social protests.
The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Supreme Court Headed Toward Likely Trump Clashes in New Term
item.description: The high court again takes up the president’s sweeping assertions of power, and maybe the midterms.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Tamari

item.title: Pentagon Removes Bombers From RAF Fairford Base
item.description: The Pentagon has removed bombers from the UK Royal Air Force base that was at the center of a suspected attempted terrorist attack last week. All American bombers deployed at RAF Fairford have now returned to their home bases in the US, a Defense Department official said. Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: NATO Drafts Plan to Defeat Russian Attack With Drones and AI
item.description: NATO’s top military commander is working on a strategy for achieving a quick victory against a Russian attack on its eastern flank, with a particular focus on integrating new defense technologies like drones and AI into traditional power.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Palasciano

item.title: India Seeks Bigger Role in Effort to End Russia-Ukraine War
item.description: India is taking a more direct role in efforts to end the conflict between Russia and Ukraine, engaging both sides on issues including shipping and reducing hostilities, External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar said.
item.dc:creator: Jon Herskovitz and Sudhi Ranjan Sen

item.title: Bolsonaro Pushes Lula to Brink of Defeat Ahead of Runoff
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro surged to a surprise lead over Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the first round of Brazil’s presidential election, making him the overwhelming favorite to win the runoff and take Latin America’s biggest economy sharply to the right.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Carvalho, Beatriz Reis and Simone Iglesias

item.title: Pentagon Moves Bombers From UK Base at Center of Terror Plot
item.description: The Pentagon has removed bombers based at the Royal Air Force base in the UK that was at the center of a suspected terrorist-attack attempt.
item.dc:creator: María Paula Mijares Torres and Eric Martin

item.title: UK Tories Back Heathrow Third Runway After Burnham Demurs
item.description: Britain’s opposition Conservatives pledged to do “whatever it takes” to build a third runway at London’s Heathrow airport after Prime Minister Andy Burnham declined to support the planned expansion.
item.dc:creator: Alex Wickham and Jacob Reid

item.title: Taiwan’s Envoy Prods Trump Administration on Arms Sale
item.description: Taiwan’s representative to the US projected confidence that President Donald Trump would ultimately approve additional weapons sales to the self-governing island, which has been waiting for a $14 billion arms package.
item.dc:creator: Kate Sullivan
